mechanism: Hydrochlorothiazide increases photosensitivity risk, and tretinoin also causes photosensitivity and skin irritation, potentially compounding dermatologic adverse effects and increasing risk of severe phototoxic reactions.
action: Monitor for enhanced photosensitivity; advise strict sun protection (SPF >30, protective clothing) and consider timing of dose administration or alternative antihypertensive if severe photosensitivity develops.
